where do I put the rubbish
answer:
All rubbish must be placed in tied-black rubbish bags. Please bring your rubbish bags to the black bin container with '85' written on it, which is located in the front garden. There is another wheelie bin in green for recycling only. Please bring the bins out to the side of the street before 6am on Thursday - or after 9pm the evening before, also ensure that the bin container lid is fully closed.

*Make sure to bring your keys so you do not get locked out*

question: where is the nearest hospital
answer: The nearest hospital is Charing Cross Hospital, located at Fulham Palace Rd, London W6 8RF. It has Accident & Emergency Department which opens 24h for emergencies.

question: how does the heating and hot water work
answer:
There are two boilers that provides heating and hot water on demand in the property. One is located in the wardrobe in the boot room on the ground floor. Another is located in the cupboard on the top floor in the hallway.

There are radiators in the kitchen, living room, and each bedroom, as well as heated towel raid in each bathroom. You can control the temperature of each radiators individually by using the radiator value on the bottom of the radiator. Turn the valve clockwise to decrease the heat and anti-clockwise to increase it (1 represents the lowest heating level, and 5 being the highest). To turn on the heating for the towel rail, you’ll find the power switch by the bathroom entrance and press it down to switch it on.
